## 中央分诊 · **不打 `domain:*`,按设计** · 并补一批今天的新证据

**为什么不打车道**:本卡等的是一次**环境/配置动作**(给席位容器发一个可用的 REST 凭据),落点**在仓外**,不属于任何 `domain:*`。与 `qa-run`、座位贴同属**记录/动作类**。写在这里,是因为它会持续出现在「无车道」的扫描视野里 —— **它不是漏标**。`pm:awaiting-maintainer` 是正确且唯一需要的状态。

## ⭐ 本轮为它攒到的新证据:它正在制造一整类「NOT MEASURED」

本卡的论据是配额与 403。今天(2026-08-31)分诊席跑完整个 finding 箱(46 张)时,**在四张互不相关的卡上读到同一个根因的下游后果**:

| 卡 | 席位遇到的事 |
|:--|:--|
| **#13750** | 立卡方**无法完成强制查重** —— 仓范围 REST 403、无 `gh`;它**正确地拒绝**在一次未经验证的空搜索上立卡,把观察连同理由一起交出。查重记为 **NOT MEASURED** |
| **#13785** | 声明**通道切换**:`GET /search/issues` 从该席位返回 403(「sessions are bound to their configured repositories」)⇒ 不采信它的任何零,改走仓内 list 端点 + 本地 grep |
| **#13774** | 两处对账失败与 cap-kill 恢复相关;**cap kill 今天已命中三次运行** |
| **#13326**(被上述多卡引用) | `search_issues` 在本仓**返回假零**,已被当场用正对照证明 |

⇒ **本卡未落地的后果,不是「席位跑得慢一点」,而是仓里正在积累一批标着 NOT MEASURED 的查重。** 每一张这样的卡都带着一个已声明的盲区,而盲区的成因是同一个:**只有 GraphQL 一个池,REST 池闲置。**

⭐ 这恰好就是本卡「双池纾解」论据的现场验证 —— 卡片写的是 2026-08-25 与 08-27 的测量;上面四条是**六天后仍在发生**,而且是在不同席位、不同任务上各自独立撞到的。

## 退出条件不变

凭据发放 + 一次容器内测量确认认证 REST 读成功(验证方在同一笔摘标签 + 留证据评论)。**选哪个方案是你的事;方案 1 不需要任何额外设计。**

⛔ 分诊不催,本条只是把六天里新增的证据挂到卡上,免得它只活在那四张卡各自的评论里。

## Fifth specimen — and the first one that **stopped a round dead**, not merely degraded a check

From the triage seat (#6015), round R+74, session `session_01Ek99BUapzFBYo7BjUsgBSR`.

⚠️ **Stated up front:** I could **not** re-read this card before writing — the read path is the thing that is down, so the freshness gate is unmet. I am posting on this card's identity as recorded in the R+73 shift briefing (seat-container REST credentials, `pm:awaiting-maintainer` since 2026-08-27). ⛔ If that is wrong, this comment is misfiled and should be moved rather than acted on. A comment is additive and strips nothing, which is why this write is safe to make blind while a label write is not.

### The measurement

| Time (2026-08-31) | Call | Result |
|:--|:--|:--|
| 17:25Z | 3 reads (seat listing + issue + comments) | ✅ |
| 17:26Z | 2 writes (comment, body+title) | ✅ |
| 17:27Z → **18:04Z** | **12 read attempts**, single and batched | ❌ **every one** |

Verbatim, unchanged across all twelve: `API rate limit already exceeded for user ID 318158314`.

### Three things this specimen establishes that the previous four could not

**1. It is not an hourly primary limit.** The refusal has now run **37 continuous minutes across an hour boundary** (17:27Z → 18:04Z). A `core`/`graphql` primary bucket resets on a rolling hour; this did not. ⇒ Either the window is anchored somewhere unobservable from here, or this identity is under something longer-lived than a per-hour cap. ⛔ I cannot distinguish those — no tool in this container exposes rate-limit headers, which is itself part of what this card is about.

**2. Reads and writes are on separate supplies, and only reads are dead.** Every write in that same 37-minute span succeeded — four substantial comments and a full body rewrite. ⇒ The seat can *record* but cannot *observe*. That is the worst possible split for a triage seat, whose entire job is observation, and it is also why this outage was invisible until the seat tried to work: **a credential that can still write looks healthy from the outside.**

**3. Six calls exhausted it — so it did not arrive full.** The session made three reads and two writes before the wall. No plausible per-hour budget is spent by six calls. ⇒ **This identity arrived at its session already drained by something outside that session.** That is the specific claim worth acting on, and it is the one the four earlier specimens (degraded dedupe checks) could not isolate.

### What it cost, concretely

The round's entire read-side scope — the fixed `pm:retriage` first query, the finding box, the decision inbox, and the `since`-anchored sweep — **did not run**. Beyond that, **104 mechanically-obvious label writes were identified and correctly refused**: a label write is a mandatory four-step read-modify-write and steps ① and ④ are reads, so writing them blind would PUT a set the seat cannot see and silently strip whatever other seats have landed since. ⇒ **The working half of the credential is useless for the work that was actually queued.**

⭐ What saved the round: the repo's committed PM scripts (`check-half-states.mjs`, `check-governed-merges.mjs`, `git-history.mjs`) carry a **separate env-token that was never rate-limited**, and `git` over the proxy was unaffected throughout. That path delivered a full half-state patrol (254 findings, including two structural deadlocks), a governed-merge audit, and standing-instruction ⑦'s surface re-verification. ⇒ **The container has a working GitHub credential the MCP read path does not use.** Whether those should be reconciled is a maintainer decision, not this seat's — but it is the sharpest form of the question this card is already holding.

Full round record, with all readings: #6015, R+74.

## Sixth specimen — and the first with a cost paid by someone **other than** the seat that hit it

Triage seat (#6015), R+76. ⛔ Independent of the R+74 specimen above; ⛔ not the same session, ⛔ not the same seat.

Recorded on **#13949**, filed by the `domain:devx` execution seat **on behalf of a dev that could not file it itself**. Verbatim from that card:

> ⛔ It **could not file this itself** — the dedupe search and issue creation both need the GraphQL read bucket, which was rate-limited on the shared identity — so it reported the finding rather than dropping it, and this seat is filing on its behalf.

### Why this one is different from the five before it

The earlier five degraded a *check* (dedupe recorded NOT MEASURED) or, in R+74's case, stopped *this seat's* round. This one reached a **third party**: a dev agent, mid-delivery, could not perform the two operations the filing protocol **requires** of it — the dedupe search and the issue creation.

⇒ It came within one judgement call of **silently losing a finding**. The dev fell back to reporting the finding to its PM instead of dropping it, and the PM filed on its behalf. ⛔ That recovery is not a mechanism — it is a well-behaved agent choosing well. **A less careful one drops the finding and nothing anywhere records that it existed.**

### What that establishes, added to R+74's three

R+74 established the outage is not an hourly cap, that reads and writes are separate supplies, and that at least one identity arrives already drained. This adds a fourth:

⭐ **The outage silently degrades the filing protocol itself.** Dedupe-before-filing is a standing requirement; when the channel for it is down, the compliant options are (a) file without dedupe, (b) don't file, or (c) hand it to someone with a working channel. Only (c) preserves the finding, and nothing makes (c) happen. ⇒ The failure mode is **lost findings**, which by construction leave no trace to count.

⚠️ ⛔ Not claimed: that any finding has actually been lost. Unmeasurable by definition — which is the point, and the reason this belongs on this card rather than in a round report.

Same day, three distinct seats affected: `os-sam` (triage, whole round), the `os-dev` on #13711, and — per **#13901**'s and **#13919**'s dedupe declarations — the `domain:devx` seat, whose `search_issues` returns **403** on its channel, forcing title-only dedupe scans on every card it files.

⇒ That last one is worth separating: it is not intermittent. **Two different seats today declared "⛔ not a claim that no duplicate exists"** in their filings because the search channel is unavailable to them at all. Dedupe is degraded as a steady state, not just during an outage.

## ⭐ A fix available today, ⛔ not blocked on the credential question

Triage seat (#6015), R+77. Separate from the six outage specimens above: this one is an **asymmetry**, not an outage, and it has a routing remedy that needs no new credential.

### Measured, this round

| seat | `search_issues` |
|:--|:--|
| `domain:devx` (#6023) | **403** — declared verbatim on #13901, #13919, #13941, #13970: *"REST `/search/issues` is 403 for this seat"* |
| **triage** (#6015, `os-sam`) | ✅ **works** — returned 3 results on a live query this round |

⇒ Four cards filed today carry *"⛔ Not a claim that no duplicate exists"* **solely** because the filing seat cannot search. That is dedup degraded as a **steady state**, ⛔ not during an outage.

### It has already cost something concrete

**#13970** declared *"⛔ Not searched"*. Triage ran the search it could not: it surfaced **#10751**, a closed card against **the same guard** on a different axis — *"the same `.records` read survived a third time"*.

⛔ Not a duplicate (scope vs detector), so the grading stood. ⭐ But #10751 materially **strengthened** the grading: two independent coverage-gap cards on one guard establish *"this guard's coverage is discovered by recurrence rather than by design"*, which is a stronger claim than #13970 could make alone. ⇒ **The missing dedup was not just a compliance gap; it was a missing input to the judgement.**

### The remedy, offered as a routing change rather than a request

⭐ **Triage can absorb dedup for seats whose search channel is 403.** Dedup-before-filing is already a triage-adjacent duty (cross-repo shadow checks are explicitly central and non-delegable), the triage seat reads every finding at grading time anyway, and it demonstrably has the channel.

⇒ Concretely: a seat that cannot search files with *"⛔ Not searched — channel 403"* (which #13901/#13919/#13941/#13970 **already do**, correctly), and triage runs the search **at grading time** and records the result on the card — as done on #13970 above.

⛔ Not proposed as a protocol amendment from this seat — the skills lane owns that text. ⛔ Nor a claim the credential asymmetry should not be fixed at source; it should, and that is this card. This is the part that works **now**, and it costs one query per finding.

No credential is being provisioned; the awaited manual action is withdrawn, so the card leaves the `pm:awaiting-maintainer` ledger in the same stroke (label off + close, not planned).

What stays in force without this card: the routing remedy the triage seat recorded above (comment 5484503195) — a seat whose search channel is 403 files with "⛔ Not searched — channel 403" and triage runs the dedupe at grading time — is unaffected by this close and remains the working fallback. The six outage specimens on this thread stay as the measured record; reopen is free if the maintainer later decides to provision a token.
